abilities.name: Boulder Smash
abilities.desc: Earth Spirit smashes the target enemy or ally, sending them in the direction he is facing. If Earth Spirit targets an area, he will smash the nearest unit in a 200 radius, prioritizing Stone Remnants. The travelling unit or Remnant damages all enemy units it hits.  If an enemy is hit by a Stone Remnant, they are also slowed. Stone Remnants travel further than other units.

abilities.name: Rolling Boulder
abilities.desc: Earth Spirit gathers himself into a boulder and, after a 0.6s delay, rolls toward the target location, dealing 60/70/80/90 + 100% STR damage and stunning enemy units. He will stop if he collides with an enemy hero or is stunned. If he rolls over a Stone Remnant, he will travel further and faster, and stun enemies for longer.

notes.note0: Rolling over a Stone Remnant will destroy the Remnant.
notes.note1: The boulder has a radius of 160.
notes.note2: Earth Spirit is untargetable and invulnerable while rolling.

abilities.name: Geomagnetic Grip
abilities.desc:
Earth Spirit pulls the target Stone Remnant or Allied Unit. Enemies struck by the gripped target will be silenced.

Pulled Remnants also deal damage to struck enemies.

Cast range is reduced when targeting an ally.

notes.note0: Will not work on a unit inside Chronosphere, Duel, or Black Hole.
notes.note1: Geomagnetic Grip can also target allied creeps.

abilities.name: Stone Remnant
abilities.desc:
Call a Stone Remnant to the target location.  Stone Remnants have no vision and are invulnerable, and can be used with Earth Spirit's abilities.  Calling a Stone Remnant consumes a charge, which recharge over time. Stone Remnant has 7 charges.

Earth Spirit passively gains 3.0% bonus damage per unused Stone Remnant charge, and gains an additional 7.5% bonus damage for 10s when a Stone Remnant is targeted with an ability (does not stack).

abilities.name: Enchant Remnant
abilities.desc:
Earth Spirit temporarily enchants a hero, granting them the properties of a Stone Remnant. After a short duration the remnant shatters, releasing the hero and damaging nearby enemies. 

Can be cast on Stone Remnants. Has a 5 second cooldown when used that way.
Has a larger cast range when cast on an ally hero.

notes.note0: Earth Spirit himself can be targeted by Boulder Smash if he is enchanted.

abilities.name: Magnetize
abilities.desc: Magnetizes units in a small nearby area, causing them to take damage for a short duration. Magnetized heroes cause nearby Stone Remnants to explode, destroying the remnant and refreshing Magnetize's duration on all nearby enemies. This process can repeat multiple times. If an enemy hero is affected by Geomagnetic Grip or Boulder Smash, all magnetized heroes share the effects.

abilities.name: Berserker's Call
abilities.desc: Axe taunts nearby enemy units, forcing them to attack him while he gains bonus armor during the duration.
abilities.shard: Berserker's Call applies Battle Hunger to affected units.

abilities.name: Battle Hunger
abilities.desc: Enrages an enemy unit, causing it to take damage over time until it kills another unit or the duration ends. The enemy is slowed as long as they are facing away from Axe.

notes.note0: Destroying buildings will also remove the debuff.

abilities.name: Counter Helix
abilities.desc: After a set number of attacks, Axe will perform a helix counter attack, dealing pure damage to all nearby enemies.

notes.note0: Counter Helix triggers when the attack hits.
notes.note1: Illusions' counters don't increase when they attack when you have a Scepter.

abilities.scepter: Counter Helix now applies a stacking debuff to enemies hit by it that causes them to deal less total attack damage to Axe. Counter Helix no longer has a cooldown and its counter advances when Axe attacks.

abilities.name: Culling Blade
abilities.desc:
Axe spots a weakness and strikes, dealing pure damage. When an enemy hero is killed with Culling Blade, its cooldown is reset, and all nearby allied units gain bonus movement speed and armor.

Axe permanently drenches his blade every time he kills an enemy Hero with Culling Blade, gaining bonus armor for each stack.

notes.note0: Culling Blade death cannot be prevented with other abilities like Shallow Grave.

abilities.name: One Man Army
abilities.desc: Axe gains Strength based on 50% of his Armor as long as there are no allied heroes within 700 distance from Axe.  The effect fades over 3s after approaching an ally.

abilities.name: Chaos Bolt
abilities.desc: Throws a mysterious bolt of energy at the target unit. It stuns for a random duration and deals random damage.

notes.note0: The stun duration and damage values dealt are inversely related.
notes.note1: Nearby illusions will mimic the cast animation.

abilities.shard: Causes Chaos Bolt to create a Phantasm illusion to attack the target. This illusion deals 0% less damage.

abilities.name: Reality Rift
abilities.desc: Teleports Chaos Knight, any illusions he has, and the target unit to a point along the line between him and the target. The enemy unit has their armor reduced for 6s.

notes.note0: Chaos Knight and the target unit are made to face each other, and Chaos Knight and his phantasms are issued an attack order against the target.

abilities.shard: Allows Reality Rift to be cast on any enemy hero that is within 1200 range of you or one of your illusions. Gathers all of your illusions and your hero and teleports them to the target enemy.

abilities.name: Chaos Strike
abilities.desc: Chaos Knight and his illusions' attacks have a chance to deal a critical strike of varying strength with bonus lifesteal. Lifesteal from creeps is reduced.

abilities.name: Phantasm
abilities.desc:
Summons several phantasmal copies of the Chaos Knight from alternate dimensions. The phantasms are illusions that deal 60/80/100% damage, but take 350% damage.
DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

notes.note0: Removes most negative buffs from Chaos Knight.
notes.note1: Chaos Knight is invulnerable for 0.5 seconds when casting, allowing him to dodge stuns and damage.

abilities.scepter:
Gains a passive component.  When an illusion of Chaos Knight is created, there is a 0% chance to create an additional illusion under Chaos Knight's control.

When Phantasm is activated, also creates an illusion of allied heroes globally.

abilities.name: Cold Feet
abilities.desc: Places a curse on an enemy, dealing damage over time.  If the enemy unit doesn't move outside of the given range from the initial location, it will be stunned and frozen in place after 4.0/4.0/4.0/4.0 seconds.

abilities.name: Ice Vortex
abilities.desc: Creates a vortex of icy energy that slows, deals damage, and increases magic damage done to enemies in its range.

notes.note0: Provides vision in a small area where it is placed.

abilities.name: Chilling Touch
abilities.desc: Enhances Ancient Apparition's attack with increased range and a burst of magical damage and slow.

abilities.name: Bone Chill
abilities.desc: When Ancient Apparition deals Magic damage to an enemy with his abilities, it is slowed for a short duration. If the target is a Hero, its Strength is also reduced. Multiple instances of this effect stack and have independent durations.

abilities.name: Ice Blast
abilities.desc: Launches a tracer toward any location on the battlefield, which must be triggered again to mark the area to be blasted by a damaging explosion of hail. The further the tracer travels, the larger the explosion will be. Enemies caught in the explosion, or who touch the icy ball of hail as it travels, are Frostbitten, taking damage over time and prevented from regenerating or healing. If a Frostbitten unit's health drops below a certain percentage, they will instantly shatter.

notes.note0: Upon cast, this ability is replaced by Release, used to stop the tracer on the target area.
notes.note1: The area of effect is 300 + 50.0*TimeTraveled, capped at 1000.
notes.note2: Kill will be granted to the source of the damage that triggers the shatter.
notes.note3: The shatter effect doesn't work on illusions.
notes.note4: The HP Freeze prevents most kinds of healing, including the fountain, except Sunder, Time Lapse and Supernova.

abilities.shard: Freezes enemies hit with the current level of Cold Feet for 0% of the duration.

abilities.name: Release
abilities.desc: Releases the ice blast to explode at the tracer's current location. Can be cast while silenced.

abilities.name: Hoof Stomp
abilities.desc: After a brief windup, Centaur Warrunner slams the ground, stunning and damaging nearby enemy units. During the delay, he is disarmed but can move.

abilities.name: Double Edge
abilities.desc: Centaur strikes a mighty blow at melee range, damaging both himself and a small area around the target. Deals extra damage based on your strength. Centaur cannot die from Double Edge.

notes.note0: Double Edge deals magic type damage to both the targets and himself.

abilities.shard: Causes Double Edge to slow enemy heroes and increase Centaur's strength per hero hit for a short time. Duration refreshes per stack, up to a max of  stacks.

abilities.name: Retaliate
abilities.desc: Centaur counters all attacks, dealing damage back to the attacker. Returns a fixed amount plus a percentage of your strength. Deals half damage to towers.

notes.note0: Retaliate triggers when the attack hits.
notes.note2: Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

abilities.name: Work Horse
abilities.desc: Centaur hitches a cart behind him. While active, Centaur gains the benefit of Stampede for the current level of Stampede, and can cast Hitch a Ride on a target ally.

abilities.name: Stampede
abilities.desc: Centaur leads all allies into a vicious charge causing them to move through units at max speed and slow any enemy units they trample. Trampled enemies take damage based on Centaur Warrunner's strength. Each enemy can be trampled once.

abilities.name: Horsepower
abilities.desc:
Centaur Warrunner gains 40% of his strength as bonus movement speed.

 This Movement speed bonus does not stack with bonuses from boots.
